steps: In render_pr, replace the [:80] cut of the issue's first line with the rule: L unchanged if len<=80; else cut the first 81 characters before their last space, rstrip, append '...'; if there is no space or nothing remains, use L[:80] + '...'.
Keep the contract-name prefix, the cell(title, 120) cleaning and everything else in PR.md unchanged.
risks: Off-by-one: the cut must look at 81 characters (so a word ending exactly at 80 is kept whole), not 80.
Changing the stripping of the issue or the cell() call would alter other output.
An empty issue must still give 'name: ' without an error.
